Verses.1: They walked around in the midst of the flames, singing hymns to God, and blessing the Lord.
Verses.2: Then Azariah (Abednego) stood still in the fire and prayed aloud:
Verses.3:
Blessed are You, Lord, God of our ancestors!
	Your name is worthy of praise and glory forever!
Verses.4:
For You are just in all You have done.
	All Your works are true, and Your ways right,
	and all Your judgments are true.
Verses.5:
You are truly just! All that you have brought upon us
	and on Jerusalem, the holy city of our ancestors,
	are a fair judgment because of our sins.
Verses.6:
For we have sinned and, in our disobedience, turned away from You.
	In all things, we have failed.
Verses.7:
We did not obey Your commandments. We ignored them.
	We did not do what you gave us for our own good.
Verses.8:
All that You have brought upon us, and all You have done to us,
	has been a deserved judgment.
Verses.9:
You have given us over to our enemies, to hateful people who reject your commandments,
	and to an unjust king. The most wicked king the world has known.
Verses.10:
Now we cannot open our mouths. All of Your servants who worship You
	are living buried in their own shamed and disgrace.
Verses.11:
For Your name's sake, do not abandon us forever
	or break Your covenant with us.
Verses.13:
You promised them as many descendants as stars in the heavens
	or as grains of sand on the seashore.
Verses.14:
But now, Lord, we are fewer than any nation,
	and are the most humiliated in all the world because of our sins.
Verses.15:
We are left without a ruler, prophet, or leader.
	No place for burnt offerings, or sacrifices.
	No place for gifts or incense.
There is no place to make an offering before You,
	so we may find Your mercy.
Verses.16:
But welcome us with our broken hearts and humbled spirits.
	We beg You to accept us as if every burnt offering were made.
As if thousands of burnt offerings were made,
Verses.17:
accept our repentance as a sacrifice in your presence today.
May we follow you without reservation.
	For those who trust in you will never be put to shame.
Verses.18:
And now, with our whole hearts, we follow you,
	we fear you, and we seek your face.
Verses.19:
Do not leave us in shame! Deal patiently with us
	and in the abundance of your mercy.
Verses.20:
Rescue us through your marvelous works,
	and bring glory to your name, Lord!
Verses.21:
Bring shame and disgrace upon all who have harmed your servants,
	take away their might and power,
	and destroy their strength.
Verses.22:
Show them you alone are the Lord God,
	who reigns in majesty over the whole world.
